title: Desktop Universal Tech Printer — Dual-Arm Recursive Manufacturing Cell
design_intent: ~1 m^3 external machine class; internal usable build volume necessarily smaller because arms, chamber shell, tooling, gas manifold and service volume consume space

baseline_geometry.external_class: approximately 1 m × 1 m × 1 m cabinet class
baseline_geometry.target_internal_build_zone: ~0.4–0.6 m per axis initially; exact envelope set by arm reach/tool collision study
baseline_geometry.architecture: sealed serviceable chamber + two internal tool arms + central indexed/tilting build fixture
baseline_geometry.note: a true 1 m^3 build volume would require a substantially larger machine envelope

core_principles: environment is a process tool: global chamber state and local tool shrouds may overlap
expensive gases are preferentially delivered to local cavities/shrouds and recovered
high-temperature/high-energy processes run before heat-sensitive active devices and electrochemical fills
cavities/current collectors/electrodes may be printed early; gases/electrolytes are filled and sealed late
replaceable/serviceable islands are preferred for fragile or qualification-limited active electronics
the machine recursively fabricates structural/tooling upgrades while bought precision components remain allowed seed parts

minimum_subsystems.name: sealed chamber
minimum_subsystems.minimum: pressure-capable low-differential chamber with controlled purge/reduced-pressure operation, viewports, interlocks and service access

minimum_subsystems.name: dual motion systems
minimum_subsystems.minimum: two compact 5–6 DOF arms or equivalent independent kinematic stages sharing a calibrated frame

minimum_subsystems.name: indexed build fixture
minimum_subsystems.minimum: heated/grounded/rotating or tilting workholding with datum registration

minimum_subsystems.name: post-mix feed bank
minimum_subsystems.minimum: multiple independently metered viscous/liquid feeds into disposable/static/dynamic mixer cartridges

minimum_subsystems.name: pick-place/service insertion
minimum_subsystems.minimum: vacuum gripper/tweezer head for bought dies, bearings, sensors and precision parts

minimum_subsystems.name: gas/environment manifold
minimum_subsystems.minimum: air exhaust, dry N2/Ar, vacuum/reduced-pressure, isolated local-fill port, pressure/O2/H2O sensing

minimum_subsystems.name: gas recovery
minimum_subsystems.minimum: dedicated recovery reservoir/ballast + isolation valves + particulate/condensable trapping for costly gases

minimum_subsystems.name: metrology
minimum_subsystems.minimum: camera + structured-light/laser profiling + electrical probing + temperature sensing

minimum_subsystems.name: control/safety
minimum_subsystems.minimum: deterministic machine controller, independent safety PLC/interlocks, E-stop, pressure/temp/current limits

minimum_subsystems.name: CGX/Raphael supervisory layer
minimum_subsystems.minimum: build compiler, source/evidence binding, solver selection, process schedule, residual analysis and twin updates
minimum_subsystems.constraint: never directly owns hard safety interlocks

bought_seed_components_initially: bearings/linear guides/ball screws or robotic joints
vacuum pump(s), certified valves, regulators and pressure sensors
safety controller, power electronics and compute
high-reliability semiconductor dies and specialised sensors
gas cylinders and certified pressure hardware

recursive_self_improvement.description: commercial 3D printer/CNC/robot components fabricate jigs, chamber parts, manifolds and structural pieces for first UTP
dual-arm UTP prints most brackets, manifolds, ducts, cable carriers, fixtures, housings, functional composites, conductors/dielectrics and passive devices
UTP fabricates more sensors, coils, motors/actuators, embedded buses and specialised toolheads; bought precision/vacuum/semiconductor items decrease
same IR splits into micro-cell variants and tethered/free-range site printers with local mobile process bubbles

baseline_exclusions: pyrophoric/toxic semiconductor precursor gas chemistry inside the general-purpose baseline cell
chlorine/fluorine aggressive etch chemistry in the shared chamber
high-energy powder-bed metal processing without a separately engineered safety module
true semiconductor-fab cleanliness/epitaxy claims from generic post-mix deposition
